lines.en: Well, seven hormonal teenagers and one Yumi. But if God is real, perhaps her aggressive teenage lust will kick in tonight and I can complete this collection once and for all.
lines.zh: 确切地说，是七个荷尔蒙泛滥的少女加一个 Yumi。不过如果上帝真的存在，也许今晚她那股凶猛的少女春心会发作，我就能一举集齐这套收藏了。

lines.en: The only issue now is to figure out the order in which I spend my time with them as I’m sure whoever is picked first will think they are the most loved and whoever is picked last will cry.
lines.zh: 现在唯一的问题是，我该按什么顺序陪她们——毕竟被先选中的那个肯定会觉得自己最被宠爱，被排到最后的那个肯定会哭。

lines.en: : Don’t feel bad about the order you’re going to pick us in, future husband. I took charge during our pre-slumber party meeting and informed everyone that this dilemma would short circuit your brain.
lines.zh: : 别为你要挑我们的顺序内疚啦，未来的老公。我在睡衣派对前的会议上已经当仁不让地跟大家说了，这个难题会把你的脑子烧短路。

lines.en: : Which is great because now we can just rationalize not being chosen first as a direct result of your crumbling mind!
lines.zh: : 这太棒了，因为这样一来，我们就能把没被第一个选中心安理得地归咎于你那崩坏的大脑了！

lines.en: : That’s the secret trick to how Ayane is still mentally stable after all this time fighting over you...

lines.zh: : 这是我想的那个意思吗？你们俩{i}终于{/i}成了？因为在我出现之前，你们就已经在往那个方向走了。

lines.zh: : 如果我再大几岁，而你这人根本不存在，她说不定就会。所以我就用这个说法来合理化「你居然真的在某件事上赢了我」这个事实吧。

lines.en: : So, when will the two of {i}you{/i} finally have sex?

lines.en: : Okay. So now I know to never put my hair in a ponytail around you again. Thanks.

lines.en: : It’s for your own safety, really. I-
lines.zh: : 这真的是为了你的安全着想。我——

lines.zh: : 你这是从哪儿听来的，Akira？

lines.zh: : 听来什么？这些都是我自己琢磨出来的想法，因为我是个变态。

lines.en: : So no one has directly said to you that the ponytail is the most sexual haircut before? Because that sounds eerily familiar to me for some reason and I believe there could be more to it.
lines.zh: : 所以以前从没有人当面跟你说过马尾是最性感的发型？因为不知为什么，这话听起来耳熟得诡异，我觉得其中恐怕另有隐情。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think that came from anywhere specific. I think Otoha’s right and we just both suck. Also, since when do you play piano?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得这话不是从什么特定的地方听来的。我觉得 Otoha 说得对，我们俩就是都很烂。另外，你什么时候开始弹钢琴了？

lines.en: scene secondsleepoverthing59

lines.zh: : 我弹得不太好。只是能让我的手不闲着。

lines.en: : You’re not very bad either. Like, you’ve got Heart & Soul down and that’s more than enough to impress people at parties.
lines.zh: : 你也不算差啊。你把《Heart & Soul》练熟了，在派对上露一手已经绰绰有余。

lines.en: : I’ve been asking Otoha to teach me but she keeps backing down.

lines.en: : You really never heard that anywhere? About ponytails, I mean.

lines.zh: : 你真觉得这事重要到值得问第二遍？

lines.en: : One day, that’s going to be us. And someone else will be on the other side of the wall-

lines.zh: : Io？你在嚷什么呢？一切都——

lines.en: scene secondsleepoverthing75
: Oh. Sensei’s here.
lines.zh: : 哦。Sensei 在这儿。

lines.en: : Sorry for the absence of my pants. I’d have dressed more appropriately if I knew you were coming over.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我没穿裤子。要是知道你要来，我会穿得得体一点的。

lines.en: : Your eyes look...quite pretty tonight, Uta.
lines.zh: : 你的眼睛今晚看起来……很漂亮，Uta。

lines.en: scene secondsleepoverthing76
: Thank you. So do yours. Do you still like me even though I’m a whore?
lines.zh: : 谢谢。你的也是。就算我是个婊子，你还是喜欢我吗？

lines.en: scene secondsleepoverthing77
: Well, I was {i}going{/i} to say she doesn’t seem all that bad until that last part.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我{i}本来{/i}想说她看起来没那么糟的，直到最后那句。

lines.en: : Her filter isn’t as...effective when she’s like this. Which is another reason I didn’t really think it would be good for the two of you to see each other right now.
lines.zh: : 她这样的时候，那层过滤器就没那么……管用了。这也是我觉得你们俩现在不适合见面的另一个原因。

lines.en: : You don’t need to worry about me, Io. Sensei won’t do anything to make me feel bad. And he already knows I was a little freak in Nara, so there’s no need to hide that from him {i}now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你不用担心我，Io。Sensei 不会做任何让我难受的事。而且他早就知道我在奈良的时候是个小变态，所以{i}现在{/i}也没必要瞒着他。

lines.en: : Uta...it’s still too early. You told me if you ever get bad that I’m supposed to isolate you until you start to get {i}better.{/i}
lines.zh: : Uta……还是太早了。你跟我说过，如果你哪天状态变差，我就该把你隔离起来，直到你开始{i}好起来{/i}。

lines.en: scene secondsleepoverthing78
: I don’t see how any of that is relevant when I’ve been totally fine this whole time.
lines.zh: : 可我这一直都挺好的，我不明白那些话跟现在有什么关系。

lines.en: : {i}Hah.{/i} You’re not, {i}fine.{/i} And you’d be looking out for me if I was in the same situation, so-
lines.zh: : {i}哈。{/i}你才不{i}好{/i}呢。如果换成是我，你也会这样护着我的，所以——

lines.en: : You’re being annoying. I want to hang out with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你真烦。我想跟 Sensei 待着。

lines.en: : I...that’s...
: She doesn’t mean it.
lines.zh: : 她不是那个意思。

lines.en: : No, I mean she’s {i}right.{/i} I know for a fact that I’m annoying. Uta just doesn’t point that out very often and-
lines.zh: : 不，我是说她{i}说得对{/i}。我确实知道自己很烦人。Uta 只是不常指出来而已，而且——

lines.en: : Just give us like ten minutes, okay? I won’t stay long. But we’re cashing in on Dorm Wars prizes tonight and it felt weird visiting the rest of your floor without seeing you two.
lines.zh: : 就给我们十分钟，好吗？我不会待太久。不过我们今晚是要兑现宿舍大战的奖励的，我看了你们楼层其他人却没来看你们俩，总觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot everyone else was here.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我都忘了其他人也在这儿。

lines.en: : No one has come to say hi to me. I am sad now.
lines.zh: : 没有人来看过我。我现在难过了。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Just ten minutes, Io. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 就十分钟，Io。就这么点时间。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: scene secondsleepoverthing79
I turn the lights in the living room off to help keep Uta comfortable.
lines.zh: 我把客厅的灯关掉，好让 Uta 舒服一点。

lines.en: I’m not sure how effective it is, but Io knows better what she needs during times like this than {i}I{/i} do, so I decide to just take her word for it and deal with the dark and the cold for now.
lines.zh: 我不确定这有多大用处，但在这种时候，Io 比{i}我{/i}更清楚她需要什么，所以我决定听她的，暂时忍受一下黑暗和寒冷。

lines.en: Without hesitation, Uta sits down beside me, wrapping her arms around mine and staring off in the direction of the chabudai...but I assume not really {i}seeing{/i} anything.
lines.zh: Uta 毫不犹豫地在我身边坐下，双臂环住我的一只胳膊，目光投向矮桌的方向……但我猜她其实什么也{i}没看见{/i}。

lines.en: And while I can’t say I’ve ever {i}looked{/i} like her, I’ve certainly felt like her. And I understand at least a little of what she’s going through right now...even if I’ll be ultimately unable to help her.
lines.zh: 虽说我不敢说自己{i}看起来{/i}像她那样过，但我肯定体会过她那种感觉。她现在正在经历的，我至少能懂一点点……哪怕我最终帮不了她。

lines.en: : Everyone knows I’m a bad girl now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 现在所有人都知道我是个坏女孩了，Sensei。

lines.en: : You might have to home-school me at this rate.
lines.zh: : 照这个势头下去，你可能得在家教我了。

lines.en: : I don’t think such a thing will be necessary, Uta. You’ll be back on your feet in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没这个必要，Uta。你很快就会重新站起来的。

lines.en: : I never left my feet, silly. This was always going to happen. I’ve been prepared for it from the start.
lines.zh: : 我从来没倒下过呀，傻瓜。这天迟早会来的。我从一开始就已经做好准备了。

lines.en: : Frankly, it’s amazing I lasted as long as I did here without anyone finding out about the real me.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我能在这儿撑这么久都没人发现真正的我，已经很了不起了。

lines.en: : Other other than you or Io, I mean. But you guys have been through some stuff too. And if {i}you’re{/i} doing fine, then obviously I can do fine as well.
lines.zh: : 我是说，除了你和 Io 之外。不过你们也都经历过一些事。既然{i}你们{/i}都还好好的，那我显然也能好好的。

lines.en: : It’s okay if you don’t though, Uta.
lines.zh: : 不过你就算不好也没关系，Uta。

lines.en: : You don’t {i}need{/i} to be fine. You can cry on me. You can cry on Io. And neither one of us will look at you any different for it.
lines.zh: : 你{i}不必{/i}非要好起来。你可以靠着我哭。你可以靠着 Io 哭。我们俩谁都不会因此对你另眼相看。

lines.en: : In fact, we {i}want{/i} you to cry. It’d be healthier than just {i}pretending{/i} everything is fine, at least.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我们{i}希望{/i}你哭出来。至少那比一味{i}假装{/i}一切都好要健康得多。

lines.en: : That’s the funny part. I don’t feel like crying at all.
lines.zh: : 好笑的地方就在这儿。我一点都不想哭。

lines.en: : In fact, I can’t even remember what crying feels like.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我连哭是什么感觉都记不起来了。

lines.en: : I like this, though. Holding your arm. Your warmth. Your smell.
lines.zh: : 不过我喜欢这样。挽着你的胳膊。你的体温。你的味道。

lines.en: : Is Io still watching?
lines.zh: : Io 还在看着吗？

lines.en: : No...She closed the door and is giving us some privacy.
lines.zh: : 没有……她把门关上了，给我们留了点私人空间。

lines.en: : Then, do you want to have sex with me?
lines.zh: : 那么，你想跟我做爱吗？

lines.en: : What? No. Absolutely not. That’s-
lines.zh: : 什么？不。绝对不行。那——

lines.en: : Because I’m disgusting. Right?
lines.zh: : 因为我恶心。对吧？

lines.en: : Because you want someone you can keep to yourself. And that means nothing when my body belongs to everyone. Right?
lines.zh: : 因为你想要一个能独占的人。而我的身体属于所有人，这就毫无意义了。对吧？

lines.en: : {i}Wrong.{/i} Not even {i}close{/i} to right.
lines.zh: : {i}错了。{/i}连{i}沾边{/i}都算不上。

lines.en: : You’re okay with sharing me then? Just not right now?
lines.zh: : 那你能接受跟别人分享我？只是不是现在？

lines.en: : It’s not {i}sharing{/i} you, Uta. All of that stuff is in the past. It has nothing to do with any of-
lines.zh: : 那不是{i}分享{/i}你，Uta。那些事都过去了。跟这一切都毫无关系——

lines.en: : It’s only in the past because something bad happened.
lines.zh: : 之所以说是过去了，只是因为出了坏事。

lines.en: : I’d still be taking pictures like that today if nothing ever came of it.
lines.zh: : 要是那事没闹出来，我今天照样还在拍那样的照片。

lines.en: : I still like it when people look at me.
lines.zh: : 我还是喜欢别人看我。

lines.en: : But it’s depressing.
lines.zh: : 可这很让人沮丧。

lines.en: : Because it’s only ever {i}just{/i} looking.
lines.zh: : 因为那{i}仅仅{/i}是看而已。

lines.en: : And even though you know I want you very very very very very very badly, you can’t bring yourself to touch me.
lines.zh: : 而且就算你知道我非常非常非常非常非常非常想要你，你还是没法说服自己来碰我。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: if iospring3 == True:
: Because I’ve already made that mistake before. And even if I {i}was{/i} just showing you love in the fucked up way I’ve come to know it, I know you wouldn’t feel it.
lines.zh: : 因为我以前已经犯过这个错了。而且就算我{i}只是{/i}在用我所熟悉的那种扭曲的方式向你表达爱，我也知道你是感受不到的。

lines.en: : You don’t feel anything right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在什么都感觉不到。

lines.en: : You’re merely pretending to.
lines.zh: : 你只是在假装罢了。

lines.en: else:
: Because I care about you. So much that even the thought of taking advantage of the state you’re in right now makes me sick to my stomach.
lines.zh: : 因为我在乎你。在乎到光是想想趁你现在这个状态占你便宜，我就想吐。

lines.en: : Did you get them this time?
lines.zh: : 这次你收到了吗？

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : There were a lot.
lines.zh: : 有很多。

lines.en: : I’m doing all {i}sorts{/i} of stuff in them.
lines.zh: : 我在里面做着{i}各种各样{/i}的事。

lines.en: : I hope you saw.
lines.zh: : 我希望你看到了。

lines.en: : No you don’t.
lines.zh: : 你才不希望。

lines.en: : Yes I do.
lines.zh: : 我就是希望。

lines.en: : I want you to know I’d do all of that and more for you.
lines.zh: : 我想让你知道，为了你，那些事我都愿意做，还能做得更多。

lines.en: : One thousand pictures just to hold your hand. A thousand more to kiss your cheek.
lines.zh: : 一千张照片，只为能牵你的手。再加一千张，只为能吻你的脸颊。

lines.en: : How many would I need to take for you to consume me?
lines.zh: : 我要拍多少张，你才肯把我吞下去？

lines.en: : Just buy me a camera and I will take them all.
lines.zh: : 只要给我买台相机，我全都拍给你。

lines.en: scene black
: And then, it will be nothing but black.
lines.zh: : 然后，就只剩下一片漆黑。

lines.en: : So you can fill the void with me.
lines.zh: : 这样你就可以用我来填满那个空洞。

lines.en: : I’d be happiest if you just swallowed me whole.
lines.zh: : 你要是能把我整个吞下去，我会最开心的。

lines.en: : But I apologize in advance for the taste.
lines.zh: : 不过我得提前为我的味道道歉。

lines.en: : This fruit was ripe before I ever met you.
lines.zh: : 这颗果子在我遇见你之前就已经熟透了。

lines.en: : It is practically inedible now.
lines.zh: : 现在它基本上已经没法吃了。
